decisions.notes: All 3 low-confidence calls accepted as proposed: CDISC=Other / anonymous (SDO; alternative Trade association); Rebecca Baker=Academic / independent (consistent with FDA-2020-D-2307; resolves the deferred affiliation question); XML4Pharma=CRO / data & tech vendor. Medium calls accepted (Critical Path Institute, Michael Einkauf, McKesson).

14 themes. Template carried forward: starts from the approved FDA-2020-D-2307 codebook v1 (T01–T12 ids kept for cross-guidance comparison); T13 (choice of data standards & Data Standards Catalog) and T14 (mapping, transformation & controlled terminology) added from this docket's comments; T09 narrowed to guidance alignment & harmonization. Above the skill's 8–12 range by JDD choice, for comparability.
Method described as codebook-based (directed) qualitative content analysis / template analysis, not reflexive thematic analysis. Single AI coder under a human-approved codebook.
Same rule as FDA-2020-D-2307: within a comment, a reiterated point counts once unless a later instance makes a genuinely section-specific point. Applied during coding.
Add a human spot check of theme coding (seeded random 10-15% of asks: theme_id and stance), alongside the existing concordance spot check. Applies to this docket and retroactively to FDA-2020-D-2307.

T07 and T09 example spans had been taken from the part of PhRMA's attachment (-0032) that is its appended FDA-2020-D-2307 letter. Replaced with spans from this docket's own letters (T07: -0032-A08; T09: -0030-A16). Definitions unchanged; codebook stays v1.

Exclude PhRMA -0032-A39..A108 (70 asks): they come from PhRMA's appended FDA-2020-D-2307 letter, already coded in that docket as 2307-0063. Rule: asks are coded against the guidance of the docket they were filed in, provided they address that guidance.

Run TypeSafe Jev as an independent, blind second coder (theme and stance) on all asks in both dockets; report agreement, Cohen's kappa, confusion matrix and confidence-ranked disagreements. Human spot check remains the reference.

Final's footnotes extracted to concordance/final_footnotes.md and accepted as evidence (FDA moved glossary definitions into footnotes). Catalog-content asks treated as requests about a separate FDA resource (not assessable) unless they ask the guidance text to say something — the analogue of the existing 'other guidances' rule.

Reviewed items 1-15 of the seeded random-order theme sample (n=15 of 324 asks); stopping point set by reviewer time. Theme 15/15 agree (0 unsure; Wilson 95% CI 79.6-100.0%). Stance 15/15 (0 unsure; 79.6-100.0%). Human vs Jev: theme 12/15, stance 12/15.

Concordance spot check: items 2-20 of the seeded random-order sample saved (n=19 of 324 calls); item 1 (0028-A60) has no saved verdict. Agreement 19/19 = 100% (Wilson 95% CI 83.2-100%). No corrections.
